codeConnect.label: React
evidence: The 12 previously published families remained mapped from prior runs; this run did not delete, disconnect, or recreate any existing mapping.

FinanceRow was genericized into one variant set (96:1147) whose text/boolean/instance properties mirror the code API (Label, Context + Show context, Value, Value context + Show value context, Mark, Show chevron) plus two variant dimensions: Layout (Title aligned [default] | Centered (legacy)) and Value tone (Default | Success | Error | Muted). The original component id 12:60 is preserved as the Centered (legacy) variant and keeps its prior Code Connect mapping; Home — funded still instances it. The title-aligned default 96:1130, the tone variants (112:1136 Success, 112:1147 Error, 112:1158 Muted), and the FinanceRow usage showcase (116:1154) are new and unpublished.

add_code_connect_map for the FinanceRow set (96:1147 -> apps/web/components/finance-rows.tsx) returns 'Published component not found' until the set is published; the same applies to SignedBalanceBar (91:927) and ActivityLoader (91:932). Renaming Figma component properties does not change the node->file Code Connect mapping.
get_code_connect_map still returns an empty object for this file (known Figma API read-back defect); Jesse approved that combined evidence on 2026-09-22.

Run 24 (publish-ready closeout) changed only definitions, descriptions, variant value names, positions, and the new color/market-gain variable; no component or set was deleted, recreated, or detached and no Code Connect mapping was touched. Renaming variant values (e.g. Kind=cash -> Kind=Cash) keeps node IDs and node->file mappings.
codeConnect.limitation: Code Connect maps Figma to code metadata; it does not synchronize React changes into Figma or Figma edits into code automatically.
codeConnect.actionRequiredFromJesse: Publish the Home Library revision (see componentInventory.publishChecklist), then add the three set-level Code Connect mappings listed there; production adoption is a separate issue.

components.fidelityNotes: One genericized row mirroring the code FinanceRow API and its ActivityRow/BalanceRow/AssetRow wrappers. Title aligned is the only layout used across Home — final's nine rows (three Your money + six Activity); the legacy Centered variant (12:60) is retained solely to keep Home — funded truthful to current production and keeps its Code Connect mapping. Value tone is a variant dimension whose value text is bound to Home-token color variables, so tone is a component property rather than a per-instance fill override. Home — final follows 'money in is green' (comment 1938656305) using activity-presenter incoming/outgoing/self semantics: Received (113:1228, 113:1348) and Borrowed loan proceeds (113:1324) use Success; Sent (113:1251, outgoing), Swapped (113:1274, neutral), and Deposited to Savings (113:1301, a self move between the user's own accounts) stay Default. Design-only differences production adoption must reconcile: the title-aligned value layout and the Value context slot are not yet exposed in code; code maps valueTone success to primary and TransferActivityRow does not set valueTone (direction is carried by the mark), so green money-in values need a production change; Borrow Cash's 5.1% APY must reconcile with the variable-APR contract; the design fixture shows '+' on Swapped and Deposited, whereas the presenter's self direction has no sign.

New component for the signed total-balance allocation bar (Borrow segment left of a zero axis, then Cash and Investments right). Design-only: production renders this inline inside HomePanel rather than as a discrete reusable component, so there is no discrete code owner to Code-Connect yet. Created so Home — final has no one-off bar layer.

New component for the Activity infinite-scroll continuation boundary with a centered spinner. Design-only: production renders ShimmerRows at the loading boundary, not a single centered spinner, so this documents a deliberate design difference rather than a mapped code component.
Represents the separate ghost Button + Item + ChevronRight composition used for each More row. Not used on Home — final; retained for the funded baseline.

frames.fidelityNotes: The approved final Home design at 390x844, first in the Screens section. Every Your money row (Cash, Investments, Borrow Cash) and every Activity row (six) is a single genericized FinanceRow instance (Layout=Title aligned) configured only through component properties, named semantically (Balance / …, Activity / …). Money-in Activity values (Received ×2, Borrowed) use Value tone=Success (color/market-gain); the rest use Default. A programmatic audit (2026-09-23) reports 23 top-level instances, zero non-instance content leaves, and zero nested overrides; the only instance overrides are instance-root name, size, and layout positioning. Rows are inset 32 px from the frame edge (16 px content + 16 px card padding), 326 px wide. Home — funded stays the current-production baseline until the production adoption PR lands. Production is unchanged.

markAssets.note: Real, license-clean SVGs imported in place into the existing CurrencyMarkSlot variants (set 12:59, all variant IDs preserved). Design-source work only; no production dependency was added.
markAssets.shadcnCoverage: shadcn's default icon set is lucide (this repo already uses iconLibrary lucide with lucide-react). No single shadcn registry covers flags + fiat/crypto + stocks; the smallest honest combination is lucide (ISC) + flag-icons or circle-flags (MIT) + cryptocurrency-icons (CC0). Per-stock brand logos are trademark-encumbered and need a dedicated licensed source; the generic mark is the stock fallback for now.

residualDifferences: Home — final (92:922) is the approved final Home design; Home — funded (13:19) remains the production baseline until the adoption PR lands; v1 (65:503), v2 (81:700), and the explorations are superseded review history inside the 'History (superseded)' section (145:1638).

Home — final applies the title-aligned FinanceRow to the Activity rows as well as the three Your money rows for a coherent screen; Jesse's inline-amounts comment scoped it to the three categories, so this Activity coherence is a design choice to confirm.

The title-aligned value layout and the Value context slot are a design change from production's items-center FinanceRow rendering; production adoption must decide whether to expose them in code and reconcile Borrow Cash's 5.1% APY with the variable-APR contract.

SignedBalanceBar and ActivityLoader are design-only components: production renders the allocation bar inline in HomePanel and uses ShimmerRows (not a single centered spinner) at the Activity loading boundary.

FinanceRow set (96:1147), SignedBalanceBar (91:927), and ActivityLoader (91:932) are unpublished; Code Connect cannot map them until Jesse publishes the Home Library. The existing Centered (legacy) variant (12:60) keeps its prior mapping.

Figma money-in values are green (color/market-gain); production still renders FinanceRow valueTone success as primary and Activity rows without a valueTone. Adoption needs a production change and belongs to the adoption issue, not this Figma closeout.

In a component set the text-property default is shared by every variant, so MoneyBreakdownItem definitions all read 'Cash', Button definitions both read 'Add money', and TabItem definitions both read 'Home'; every instance overrides the label. The variant grid differs by dot colour, fill, and icon.
The browser uses the system sans stack while Figma resolves SF Pro/Inter text styles; glyph metrics and rasterization differ slightly.
MoneyTicker and navigation transitions are static in Figma; Figma does not execute pagination, network, retry, focus, history, account switching, reduced motion, or wallet behavior.

Updating shared component definitions (marks, MoneyBreakdownItem borrow) also refreshes the superseded frames and the funded baseline, since they instance the same nodes; this is intended component behavior and does not change any frame structure. The FinanceRow Centered (legacy) variant preserves the funded baseline's amount alignment.
The rendered US flag mark uses twemoji artwork scaled uniformly; its intrinsic aspect is compact rather than a 1.9:1 physical flag, acceptable at the 32px mark scale.

Run 24 regrouped the Components section (11:767) under seven category headings and reordered Screens (11:768): Approved final, Current production baseline, then the nested 'History (superseded)' section (145:1638) with v1, v2, and the explorations. Pairwise bounding-box audits report zero overlaps among the Components top-level children, the Screens children, and the History children. Only positions, parents (history frames moved into the nested section), names of variant values, and descriptions changed; no node was deleted except the stray sample instance 64:522 and its label 64:521.

Borrow Cash's context copy was shortened to the Jesse-approved one-line 'Against your investments' in Home — final (113:1204) and the FinanceRow — usage reference (116:1179); it renders on one line at the 326 px Home row width. Superseded frames (v2 81:700, v1 65:503) retain their historical 'Borrow against your investments' copy.
